descriptor: Google Ads recovery, Fairfield service pages, and estimate quality
status: August delivery recovered, but the controlled replacement and conversion cleanup remain open
signal: Onsite generated 538 clicks on $88.07 in August spend at a $0.16 average cost per click. Google reported four conversion events, while exact estimate quality and the account's conversion setup remain pending validation.
goal: Finish the controlled Search replacement, validate connected calls and accepted forms, and use qualified estimate quality to guide September delivery.

benchmark.detail: August blended CPC than the 2026 Home & Home Improvement search benchmark; directional only because Onsite's placement mix differs from pure Search.

work: Reconfigured the account after delivery stopped and restored delivery following Google's review.
Completed a call-volume recovery audit and defined a controlled Search replacement around qualified estimates.
Published two Fairfield service pages with focused FAQs and maintained the dedicated paid-search destination.
Kept duplicate call, form, and micro-action events separate from real estimate outcomes.
analysis: The account produced very inexpensive traffic, but the blended CPC is not directly comparable to a pure Search benchmark because the placement mix differs. Traffic efficiency is therefore a directional strength, not proof of qualified lead efficiency.

The material September decision is measurement quality. Connected service-fit calls and accepted forms must become the primary evidence before the controlled Search replacement is treated as complete.

platforms.name: Google Ads
platforms.note: The spending campaign generated 538 clicks on $88.07 at a 4.03% click-through rate. Google reported four conversion events, while conversion actions and enhanced measurement remain pending validation.

platforms.name: Website and local search
platforms.note: The dedicated paid-search page remained live, and two Fairfield service pages were confirmed published with focused FAQs.

outcome.platform: Google delivered 538 clicks on $88.07 and reported four conversion events.
outcome.business: Qualified estimates, booked projects, and revenue are not reconciled to the platform events.
outcome.measurement: Validate connected calls and accepted form receipts, then complete the controlled Search transition without using micro-actions as lead proof.
